home.q: Is it safe to buy an under-construction flat?
home.a: Yes, if the project is MahaRERA registered. RERA requires timelines, approvals and quarterly progress to be published, and buyer money to be held in a dedicated project account.

home.q: How do I check if a project is RERA registered?
home.a: Search the project's MahaRERA number on maharera.maharashtra.gov.in, or scan the QR code on its advertisement. Every Prabhav project shows its number on the project page.

home.q: What is the difference between carpet area and built-up area?
home.a: Carpet area is the usable floor inside your walls. Built-up area adds wall thickness and balconies. Under RERA, prices must be quoted on carpet area.

home.q: What documents do I need to buy a flat in Maharashtra?
home.a: PAN card, Aadhaar, address proof, passport-size photos and income proof if you're taking a home loan. Our team shares a full checklist at booking.

home.q: What are stamp duty and registration charges in Maharashtra?
home.a: Stamp duty is a percentage of the agreement value (commonly around 6% in MMR cities) plus registration of 1%, capped at ₹30,000. Rates change, so always confirm the current figures before booking.

home.q: Can I get a home loan for an under-construction property?
home.a: Yes. Banks disburse in stages as construction progresses. Prabhav projects are approved by leading banks.

home.q: What is an Occupancy Certificate (OC) and why does it matter?
home.a: The OC confirms the building was built as per approved plans and is safe to occupy. It's needed for utility connections, resale and home loans on ready flats.
